title: gcz.20: '-' delimiter in is_begin_line correctly handles begin-base64 path
description: Allowing '-' as a valid post-keyword delimiter in is_begin_line ensures that 'begin-base64' blocks still pass the initial gate and reach handle_block(), where is_begin_base64() fires first. Without '-', 'begin-base64' blocks would be silently skipped by the outer scan_impl loop and the BeginBase64 error would never be emitted. A reviewer might suggest removing '-' support to simplify the function, which would break begin-base64 detection. The '-' case is load-bearing.
close_reason: Confirmed: no code change needed. Existing implementation is correct per review analysis.
